about: Source-indexed decomposition of the chosen references. Regions are pixel boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] in the named source. P = refs-local/commons-atf-mossberg-590.jpg (1148 x 263, right side, public domain). L = refs-local/commons-peo-590a1-cropped-1280.jpg (1920 x 389, left side of a 590A1, public domain; left-side controls only). M = owner's manual 103855, by PDF page and figure (not committed). status: built | merged (into the part named) | omitted (reason in notes/NOTES.md).
grid: P was inspected in a 12 px column grid (model/tools/trace_reference.py prints every column's covered runs) and in three enlarged crops: stock x 0..500, receiver x 333..733, front x 667..1148.

features.what: buttstock: straight comb rising to the receiver, pistol-grip wrist, belly line to the toe
recoil pad, joint line slanted (top x 54, bottom x 75), toe further forward than heel
slanted vent slots moulded into the pad's side (about 12)
rear sling swivel stud under the stock
receiver: flat sides, flat top from x 405 to 570, rear slope down to the stock joint, small bevel at the front
safety button: ribbed slider on the top rear slope
ejection port, rounded corners; the bolt fills it with the action closed
extractor and its slot at the bolt's front right
trigger housing retainer pin, round head
small hole under the port: taken as an elevator stud hole (manual p16: the elevator's studs fit 1/4 in holes in the receiver)
small round plug on the receiver side, upper rear; the left-side photo shows one at the same place (L04). Function not identified
two filler screws seen at the top edge (x 446 and 510)
trigger guard loop and the housing's lower edge under the receiver
trigger blade, curved forward at the tip
barrel: collar at the receiver, taper over the first 230 px, then parallel to the muzzle
bead front sight
magazine tube under the barrel, full length
action slide bar between barrel and tube, running into the forend (right bar seen; left assumed by symmetry, manual Fig. 22 names bars in the plural)
forend: round, rear lip, about 19 ring ribs from x 735 to 850, smooth nose with a rounded front
band around barrel and tube with a lug hanging below it (bayonet lug)
barrel takedown ring around the tube (manual p6: the barrel's takedown mount hole slides over the magazine tube)
magazine cap with the front swivel stud at its tip
stock to receiver joint, slanted
lighting and surface: flat frontal flash on a white ground, matte dark finishes, wear specks on barrel and tube
action lock lever behind the trigger guard, left side (manual p6 Fig. 4)
ejector screw head on the left wall (manual p28 items 10 and 11)
perforated heat shield over the barrel (a 590A1 fitting, also manual p30 items 31 to 34)
round plug on the left side, upper rear (mirror of P11)
loading port in the receiver's underside, in front of the trigger guard, with the elevator closing it
maker's roll marks and serial number on the receiver
safety: rearward is ON (SAFE) and covers the red dot; forward is OFF (FIRE) and shows it
action lock lever: press it up to unlock and open the action without pulling the trigger
cartridge stop (right wall) and cartridge interrupter (left wall), loose bars held by the trigger housing
elevator: a fork with two arms and studs that pivot in the receiver; the front end lifts the shell
bolt slide under the bolt, driven by notches in both action slide bars; bolt lock on the bolt
bolt assembly, removed forwards through the barrel opening; ejector on the wall opposite the port
trigger housing assembly lifts out rear first once its pin is pushed out; front lugs hook in receiver slots
magazine follower and spring inside the tube
magazine spring; retaining ring and washer of the swivel stud; action slide tube nut; hammer and the trigger housing's internals
action slide assembly: a tube over the magazine tube carrying both bars; the forend fits over it
